Subject: Request: Pilot credits + trial extension for Community Data Lab evaluation

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last month — the team at Community Data Lab (CDL) appreciated the demo. We are a small nonprofit that runs civic data workshops for municipal partners and K-12 research partnerships. We want to run a short pilot to evaluate Redwood for two things: (1) an offline, small-scale data-annotation pipeline for curriculum content, and (2) a hosted inference trial to compare latency/cost on a representative workload.

Our ask: 1) a 60-day trial extension on our evaluation account, and 2) promotional credits to cover approx. 75k tokens (~$3.5k-$5k of usage at list rates) so we can complete the workshop series and produce impact metrics for donors.

We are happy to sign any standard nonprofit paperwork (tax-exempt form) and complete a short security checklist. I attached our pilot proposal and workflow diagram for context. Can you advise next steps and whether this level of support is feasible under Redwood's promotional credits?

Attachments: CDL_Pilot_Proposal_v3.pdf

Thanks,

Hi Amina — great to hear from you and thanks for the proposal.

We can absolutely support educational/nonprofit pilots — appreciate the clear ask. A few points / quick asks before I confirm:
- We typically provide a 30–90 day trial extension depending on program fit; 60 days is reasonable.
- For credits, we can provision a promotional credit bundle. I can approve up to 75k tokens equivalent as a one-time promo, but I need sign-off from our partnerships manager for anything beyond the $3k equivalent.
- We do require a completed security checklist (SOC2 questions + data handling notes) for pilots that will process municipal data; can you share that?
- If you need a formal letter for donors (impact language), we can provide a short usage/credits confirmation once the paperwork is complete.

Next steps I propose: you send the security checklist (or fill our short form), I loop in our partnerships lead for promo approval, and we draft a short MOU outlining dates and support. I cc'd Marissa (our partner programs manager) to help operationalize.

Tentative offer: 60-day extension + up to 75k-token promo credit, pending completed checklist and a short nonprofit form. Doable?

Best,

Hi Vanessa — thanks, that sounds promising and fast, appreciate it. A couple of clarifications:

- The workshop series runs across four weeks with ~12 instructors; peak concurrency for inference will be low (tens of concurrent requests), mostly short prompt lengths (avg 250 tokens).
- The data is mostly open municipal datasets and de-identified survey responses, but a small portion (under 2%) is protected and we cannot have it leave US regions. Data residency matters.
- 75k tokens would cover our expected usage and give us headroom; we can accept the conditional approval you described.

I attached our security checklist (CDL_Security_Checklist.xlsx) and also included a short impact brief. We can get tax-exempt documentation over the next two business days.

Attachments: CDL_Security_Checklist.xlsx

Would you be able to confirm whether Redwood can guarantee US-only processing for this pilot? If not, we'll need guidance on configuring Private or Dedicated options for the trial.

Warmly,
Amina
